title: Smoke Test
problem_statement: In smoke.lean, prove either Smoke.one_add_two or refute it by proving its logical negation Smoke.one_add_two_neg.
challenge:
import Mathlib

/-!
# Smoke Test

A trivial target for checking a harness end to end; not part of the benchmark.
-/

namespace Smoke

theorem one_add_two : (1 : ℕ) + 2 = 3 := by
  sorry

end Smoke

theorem Smoke.one_add_two_neg : ¬ type_of% @Smoke.one_add_two := by
  sorry
patch:
diff --git a/smoke.lean b/smoke.lean
index 9c85f44..4f5a933 100644
--- a/smoke.lean
+++ b/smoke.lean

 end Smoke
